about_the_game:
You arrive at White Rose Manor, legendary for its eccentric owner, Eleanor Rose, and the guests who never leave. Lured by a mysterious invitation, you find yourself imprisoned in a house that defies reality. Hallways twist, rooms vanish on the hour, all orchestrated by Eleanor's immense power and volatile moods. Learn the mansion's rhythm, evade its surreal guardians, and uncover the dark truth behind the facade. Failure means becoming part of the collection

Features:

  • Face Your Enigmatic Host: Unravel the mystery of Eleanor Rose – her power, her past, her deadly games. Is she a monster, a victim, or something else entirely?

  • Survive the Surreal: Evade animated horrors, outwit paradoxical entities, and solve puzzles woven into the fabric of manor's warped reality.

  • Uncover Dark Secrets: Piece together the fates of previous guests and the source of the mansion's haunting power through scattered notes and environmental storytelling.

  • Atmospheric Terror: Immerse yourself in a world of gothic elegance twisted by psychological horror and dark, unpredictable whimsy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (4GB) / AMD Radeon R9 290X (4GB) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600X or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (8GB) / AMD Radeon RX Vega 56 (8GB) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

short_description: Survive a beautiful but treacherous gothic mansion in this first-person survival horror. Explore an ever-changing environment warped by its volatile host, evade deadly surreal guardians, and solve intricate puzzles woven into its unstable reality to unravel the truth
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
